messages:
aj: Anyone else seeing autoscaler failing to scale GPUs in us-east1 during the spike? ml-inference p50 latency >2s and queue depth is climbing.

maria: yep saw that — dashboards show failed scale attempts around 1773123400. Autoscaler logs show ProbeTimeouts. @opsbot can you dump last 30s scale events?

opsbot: [AUTOSCALER] dump-events --region us-east1 --since 1773123300
Result: 6 attempts, 4 failures, error=ProbeTimeout (healthcheck didn't return).

sam_irwin: Looks like kube-node-prober started flapping after we hit 3x expected RPS. Node join times spiked to ~90s. Probably provisioning delay at cloud provider side.

kevin: Cloud console shows successful quota, but provider API reported intermittent control-plane errors in us-east1. I opened a ticket with them (INC-9882).

maria: Rolling traffic to us-west1 now to stop user impact. @yuan start gradual shift: 20% first, then 50% if stable.

yuan: K starting canary shift: `curl -X POST https://router.internal/shift -d '{"region":"us-west1","pct":20}'`

opsbot: Router shift accepted. New route weights: us-east1 80, us-west1 20.

sam_irwin: autoscaler in us-east1 is thrashing: scale-up -> nodes pending -> healthchecks fail -> scale-down -> repeat. Downscale is kicking before nodes finish bootstrap because probe never passes.

aj: Manual override: set minReplicas=10 on inference pool `inference-gpu-v2` in us-east1 to stop oscillation.

kevin: Done. `kubectl patch hpa inference-gpu-v2 -n prod --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":10}}'` (ran at 1773123482)

maria: Found kubelet/CNI errors on new nodes: `cni: failed to allocate ip` in /var/log/kubelet — explains probe timeouts.

sam_irwin: Workaround option: cordon new nodes until CNI allocation clears. But that temporarily reduces capacity and could worsen latency if we drain incorrectly.

yuan: Suggest also increasing autoscaler cooldown to avoid thrash. Change from 30s -> 180s while provider recovers.

aj: Applying autoscaler config: `PATCH /autoscaler/config {"cooldownSeconds":180}`

opsbot: Autoscaler config updated by aj at 1773123490.

kevin: Creating cost/ops ticket since keeping minReplicas + cross-region failover will spike GPU burn. INC-9883 created and assigned to finance-alerts.

maria: Quick checklist for this thread: 1) minReplicas=10 in us-east1 (aj) 2) cooldown=180s (aj) 3) shift 20->50% to us-west1 if errors continue (yuan) 4) engage cloud provider on CNI allocation (kevin). @oncall-lisa please own the postmortem.

oncall-lisa: I got it. I'll gather logs, timeline, and schedule RCA tomorrow. Please paste exact timestamps of commands/changes below.

aj: adding timestamps: minReplicas set at 1773123482, cooldown patched at 1773123490, initial shift started at 1773123465.

maria: Provider responded: transient control-plane allocation bug in us-east1; mitigation deployed and they estimate recovery in 6-12 minutes.

opsbot: Autoscaler resumed normal operations at 1773123799. Final router weights: us-east1 65, us-west1 35.

yuan: p50 latency back to ~280ms, queue depth normalizing.

sam_irwin: Follow-ups: add probe-failure alert (rate >5/min), prewarm CNI for node pool scaleups, document manual override flow and rollback steps, and revisit default cooldown policy.

oncall-lisa: I'll include those in the postmortem action items and draft the RCA. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
